rule_or_requirement: A pixel-only candidate must retain valid completion while reducing simulated lap time.
observable_information: Current four grayscale frames, visible road centers and obstacle cues, and speed estimated from the rendered HUD; no simulator state enters inference.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Raise gas to a fixed 0.28 floor only below a bend-conditioned speed target on fully visible unobstructed road with small inherited steering and no brake.
expected_success_endpoint: TRAIN activation with changed gas and no new finish loss, then a separately registered fresh tune comparison of completion first and median finished lap time second.
control: Frozen apex_line actor with identical checkpoint hashes and the same two TRAIN cells.
falsifier: No gas-action change, invalid action, or candidate noncompletion on a cell completed by the control.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Paired official-environment TRAIN cells 1/43 and 2/102, two arms, at most 2000 decisions per cell, full action traces and envelope decision count.
resource_and_risk_gate: Linux Python 3.11 CPU diagnostic within 1800 seconds; consumed TRAIN identities only, no tune/held-out/confirmation/blind access, no website action.
